_meta.what: Single machine-readable source of truth for Emen identity, brands, lines and product portfolio. Facts only — no copy, no keywords, no voice.
_meta.rule: No file, skill, or generated content may assert a brand fact, product status, or domain that contradicts this registry. Other repos vendor a committed copy rather than importing across repo boundaries.
_meta.vendoredNote: This is a VENDORED COPY, not an independent source. The master is the ementech-website file named above; this repo cannot import across the boundary, so it commits a copy and keeps it honest by hand. If you change a fact here, change it in the master too — a fact that differs between the two is drift that no build in either repo will catch.
_meta.verified: Synced from master v2 on 2026-10-15. Live checks that day: dumuwaks.co.ke 200; dumuwaks.ementech.co.ke 301 -> it; ardalink.onrender.com 200; baitech.co.ke no DNS.

_notes.masterBrand: Restructured 2026-09-20: Emen is a master brand with three lines — Emen Lighting, Emen Tech, Emen Shop. A line is not a separate brand: one mark, one palette, one voice, one site. Products (DumuWaks, ArdaLink, SmartBiz, OnlineDuka) sit inside a line and never become a fourth line. Legal entity remains Emen Engineering Limited.
